errors.error_description: Instantiated sub-module port width mismatch: an 8-bit signal is connected to a 4-bit child port via .in(opcode).
Created bus contention by driving the same net decode_bus from two separate continuous assignments.
Declared an unreachable FSM state S_UNUSED in the enum that is never entered by any transition.
Assigned a 10-bit concatenation {opcode, 2'b01} to an 8-bit debug_byte, causing truncation.
